content:
emma: Customer reported unexplained provisional spike. Trace shows retry routed to a different region and ledger node minted a second provisional. trace=crr-21

raj: Wait — retries can route cross-region? I thought we sticky-route retries to original shard.

sam: Normally yes, but we have fallback routing where soft-fallback sends retries to nearest healthy region. If ledger dedupe state is local only, cross-region retries can create duplicate provisional entries.

leo: Logs:
```
[2025-09-01T03:14:10Z] request start session=s-200 route=us-west->eu-west prefetched=false
[2025-09-01T03:14:12Z] ledger provisional_issue id=pv-900 node=ledger-us-west invocation=inv-900
[2025-09-01T03:14:13Z] route-fallback chosen=eu-west reason=node-overloaded
[2025-09-01T03:14:13Z] ledger provisional_issue id=pv-901 node=ledger-eu-west invocation=inv-900
[2025-09-01T03:14:14Z] toolcall.confirm id=pv-901 confirmed_tokens=410
```

hana: Two provisionals (pv-900 & pv-901) for same invocation but on different ledger nodes. Customer saw a 2x provisional blip until final confirm.

emma: Support ticket is urgent. Customer wants refund flow and explanation.

raj: Short-term: change routing so retries try to prefer original ledger node for N seconds (sticky by ledger_shard_hint). Also add a circuit to avoid cross-region provisional issuance if an unresolved provisional exists.

sam: Long-term: ledger dedupe needs global idempotency key. Options: 1) central dedupe service (write-heavy), 2) replicate dedupe cache via gossip with TTL, 3) include global dedupe token (client-provided invocation_fingerprint).

leo: I vote for hybrid: prefer client-provided invocation_fingerprint when present (cheap), and add a lightweight global dedupe cache with per-invocation bloom filter replicated every 1s between ledger nodes. That avoids a central hot path but reduces cross-node dupes.

hana: UX/telemetry ask: console should show route history and ledger_node per request, plus a provisional vs confirmed timeline so support can prove duplicates were provisional-only.

emma: I'll draft customer message: explain fallback routing + provisional semantics and that we're shadowing a fix. No refunds until we verify.

ops-bot: Runbook entry created: runbook/ledgers/cross-region-dedupe. Owner: leo. ETA: 72h. Incident INC-2025-201 opened.

sam: Implementation plan: 1) quick-routing patch to prefer original ledger_shard for retries (hotfix) 2) telemetry: add `ledger_node` and `route_history` fields to billing events and `provisional_origin` enum 3) ledger shadow dedupe: accept global_key=(invocation_fingerprint || session+invocation) and run in shadow for 24h 4) dashboard: top 20 cross-node provisional dupes card.

leo: I'll wire the bloom-replication PoC and expose `crossnode_provisional_dup` metric. Start with per-region pair sampling.

hana: Console changes: request detail pane gets `route_history` and a provisional timeline graph, plus a one-click "queue provisional refund" for ops.

raj: Canary: hotfix routing immediate; shadow dedupe 1% traffic for 12h; if duplicate rate drops >90% then ramp.

emma: Action items noted. I'll notify customer and keep refunds on hold. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
